name: Hyundai Engineering & Construction Co., Ltd.
summary: Hyundai Engineering & Construction Co., Ltd. operates as a leading global player in the civil engineering and construction industry, with significant operations across South Korea, various parts of Asia (including the Middle East), Africa, and other international markets. The company organizes its extensive activities into key segments: Building/House, Infrastructure/Environment, Plant/Power, and a range of other services. In the realm of infrastructure, Hyundai E&C undertakes the development of major transportation systems such as highways, railways, and bridges. Their expertise also extends to water resource management and environmental systems, subterranean developments, as well as complex marine, offshore, and dredging initiatives. Within its building construction portfolio, the company delivers a wide array of structures, including healthcare facilities, industrial and logistics centers, hospitality establishments, residential properties, public and corporate office buildings, and specialized venues for transportation, culture, and sports. Furthermore, they construct data centers, educational and research facilities, mixed-use complexes, and various housing developments. Hyundai E&C is also a prominent contractor in the energy and industrial plant sector. This includes the engineering and construction of oil refineries, gas processing plants, petrochemical and fertilizer production facilities, and specialized plants for liquefied natural gas (LNG) and gas-to-liquid (GTL) technologies, alongside nuclear power generation facilities. Their capabilities in power generation also encompass conventional power plants, desalination facilities, renewable energy projects, and critical transmission line and substation infrastructure. Beyond its core construction and engineering projects, the company diversifies its business through real estate leasing. Its ancillary services are broad, covering architectural design, facility maintenance, agricultural and livestock management, real estate development and supply, resort property management, utility production (steam, cold, hot water, and air conditioning), equipment servicing, electricity generation, and heavy machinery rental. Established in 1947, Hyundai Engineering & Construction Co., Ltd. maintains its corporate headquarters in Seoul, South Korea.
